 - source_spec: `_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/spec-5-1-semantic-search-with-debounced-input.md`
   summary: `EntriesSearchCubit` is a `lazySingleton` paired with a stateless (uncontrolled) `TextField` in `EntriesSearchBar`, so returning to Meus Registros after navigating away (e.g. tapping a search result into entry detail, then back) shows stale search results in place of the timeline while the visible search box renders empty — no mechanism restores the box's text to match the cubit's still-live query.
   evidence: `lib/features/entries/presentation/cubit/entries_search_cubit.dart`'s own doc comment argues the singleton exists so "a query already typed survives leaving and re-entering `/meus-registros`," but `lib/features/entries/presentation/widgets/entries_search_bar.dart`'s `TextField` has no `controller`, so only the cubit's `Resource` state persists, never the displayed text; no AC or I/O-matrix row in the frozen spec exercises re-entry, so this was never caught by the committed test suite. The pattern mirrors `MeusRegistrosCubit`'s own accepted precedent (cubit data persists across visits, the screen's own `ScrollController` does not), so it isn't a novel defect, but it's real and worth a focused look — either seed the text field from the cubit's last query, or reconsider whether the singleton lifetime (vs. a `factory` mirroring `EntryDetailCubit`) buys anything here, since no "resume last query" feature actually exists today despite the stated rationale.

2	title: 'Semantic Search with Debounced Input'
3	type: 'feature'
4	created: '2026-11-05'
5	status: 'done'
6	review_loop_iteration: 0
7	context: []
8	baseline_commit: '6f6a672b3a7aa50b5b65f839796586ed2b490122'
9	---
10	
11	<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">
12	
13	## Intent
14	
15	**Problem:** Meus Registros has no way to find an Entry by meaning — a user who phrased a thought differently than how they search for it today finds nothing, and there is no search surface on the screen at all yet.
16	
17	**Approach:** Add a permanently-docked search bar to Meus Registros, backed by a new `EntriesSearchCubit` (first real `Resource<T>` consumer) that debounces input 300ms and calls a new `EntriesRepository.search()` method against `entries-search`; an empty query reverts to the normal timeline, and offline resolves immediately to `Failure.networkOffline` with no cache fallback.
18	
19	## Boundaries & Constraints
20	
21	**Always:**
22	- `EntriesRepository.search(String query)` → `Either<Failure, List<Entry>>`. `EntriesRemoteDataSource.search()` calls `ApiClient.get('entries-search', queryParameters: {'q': query})` (no `limit`/`cursor`), decodes `json['data']` with existing `EntryDto.fromJson`; extra `similarity`/`mode` fields are never read, same as other superset fields `_toEntry` already drops.
23	- `search()` is only called with a non-empty, pre-trimmed query — the cubit owns that guarantee, never the repository.
24	- On success, persist via `_toEntry`'s "persist then return" (`putAll`, mirrors `list()`). On any `Failure`, return `Left` unmapped — no cache fallback (AD-9: no client-side vector index).
25	- New `EntriesSearchCubit extends Cubit<Resource<List<Entry>>>`, starts `ResourceIdle()`. `onQueryChanged(raw)`: cancel pending debounce `Timer`; empty-after-trim → emit `ResourceIdle()`, no request; else restart a 300ms `Timer` → `ResourceLoading()` → `search()`. A monotonic `_generation` counter (mirrors `MeusRegistrosCubit._generation`) discards stale results.
26	- New `EntriesSearchBar` widget: paper-elevated (`colorSurfaceElevated`, `radiusMd`, `elevation1`), hint "Buscar nos registros...", trailing `Icons.filter_list` button (44pt, reuses `insertionModalTapTargetMin`) wired as a no-op this story (filters are 5.2); never submitted by a button — `onChanged` feeds `cubit.onQueryChanged` directly.
27	- `MeusRegistrosScreen`: dock the bar above the list; non-`ResourceIdle` search state renders search results (own 300ms skeleton threshold, mirrors `_skeletonTimer`) in place of the timeline; `ResourceIdle` shows the timeline unchanged.
28	- Register `EntriesSearchCubit` as `lazySingleton` (`dispose: cubit.close()`) in `entries_injection.dart`, mirrors `MeusRegistrosCubit`; add its resolution assertion to `bootstrap_integration_test.dart`.
29	
30	**Ask First:** none — scope is fully pinned by `epic-5-context.md` and the ACs below.
31	
32	**Never:** `source`/`dateFrom`/`dateTo` params on `search()` (5.2); a second `Entry`/DTO model; a cache fallback for search; a functional filter sheet; an update/delete method on `EntriesRepository`.
33	
34	## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix
35	
36	| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
37	|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
38	| Semantic match | query "ansiedade" | results include an entry only containing "nervosismo" | N/A |
39	| Rapid typing | 5 keystrokes within 300ms | exactly one `entries-search` call fires, for the final value | N/A |
40	| Query cleared | non-empty → empty/whitespace | pending timer cancelled, state → `ResourceIdle`, timeline shown, no request | N/A |
41	| Offline | any non-empty query, no connectivity | `ApiClient` → `Failure.networkOffline`, no cache fallback | `ResourceError(networkOffline)` rendered |
42	| Stale response | query A in flight, query B supersedes it | A's result discarded on arrival (generation mismatch) | N/A |
43	| Slow request | request exceeds 300ms | loading indicator appears | N/A — faster responses show none |
44

51	- `meus_registros_cubit.dart:48-57` — `_generation` staleness-guard pattern to mirror.
52	- `lib/core/resource.dart` — existing `Resource<T>`; first real consumer.
53	- `meus_registros_screen.dart:117-153` — wire both cubits via nested `BlocBuilder`s.
54	- `entries_injection.dart:54-60`, `bootstrap_integration_test.dart:196-197` — DI registration + assertion patterns to mirror.
55	- `design_tokens.dart` — reuse `colorSurfaceElevated`, `radiusMd`, `elevation1`, `spacingMd/Lg`, `textBodyMd`, `insertionModalTapTargetMin`; no new token.

---
title: 'Semantic Search with Debounced Input'
type: 'feature'
created: '2026-11-05'
status: 'done'
review_loop_iteration: 0
context: []
baseline_commit: '6f6a672b3a7aa50b5b65f839796586ed2b490122'
---

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** Meus Registros has no way to find an Entry by meaning — a user who phrased a thought differently than how they search for it today finds nothing, and there is no search surface on the screen at all yet.

**Approach:** Add a permanently-docked search bar to Meus Registros, backed by a new `EntriesSearchCubit` (first real `Resource<T>` consumer) that debounces input 300ms and calls a new `EntriesRepository.search()` method against `entries-search`; an empty query reverts to the normal timeline, and offline resolves immediately to `Failure.networkOffline` with no cache fallback.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- `EntriesRepository.search(String query)` → `Either<Failure, List<Entry>>`. `EntriesRemoteDataSource.search()` calls `ApiClient.get('entries-search', queryParameters: {'q': query})` (no `limit`/`cursor`), decodes `json['data']` with existing `EntryDto.fromJson`; extra `similarity`/`mode` fields are never read, same as other superset fields `_toEntry` already drops.
- `search()` is only called with a non-empty, pre-trimmed query — the cubit owns that guarantee, never the repository.
- On success, persist via `_toEntry`'s "persist then return" (`putAll`, mirrors `list()`). On any `Failure`, return `Left` unmapped — no cache fallback (AD-9: no client-side vector index).
- New `EntriesSearchCubit extends Cubit<Resource<List<Entry>>>`, starts `ResourceIdle()`. `onQueryChanged(raw)`: cancel pending debounce `Timer`; empty-after-trim → emit `ResourceIdle()`, no request; else restart a 300ms `Timer` → `ResourceLoading()` → `search()`. A monotonic `_generation` counter (mirrors `MeusRegistrosCubit._generation`) discards stale results.
- New `EntriesSearchBar` widget: paper-elevated (`colorSurfaceElevated`, `radiusMd`, `elevation1`), hint "Buscar nos registros...", trailing `Icons.filter_list` button (44pt, reuses `insertionModalTapTargetMin`) wired as a no-op this story (filters are 5.2); never submitted by a button — `onChanged` feeds `cubit.onQueryChanged` directly.
- `MeusRegistrosScreen`: dock the bar above the list; non-`ResourceIdle` search state renders search results (own 300ms skeleton threshold, mirrors `_skeletonTimer`) in place of the timeline; `ResourceIdle` shows the timeline unchanged.
- Register `EntriesSearchCubit` as `lazySingleton` (`dispose: cubit.close()`) in `entries_injection.dart`, mirrors `MeusRegistrosCubit`; add its resolution assertion to `bootstrap_integration_test.dart`.

**Ask First:** none — scope is fully pinned by `epic-5-context.md` and the ACs below.

**Never:** `source`/`dateFrom`/`dateTo` params on `search()` (5.2); a second `Entry`/DTO model; a cache fallback for search; a functional filter sheet; an update/delete method on `EntriesRepository`.

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Semantic match | query "ansiedade" | results include an entry only containing "nervosismo" | N/A |
| Rapid typing | 5 keystrokes within 300ms | exactly one `entries-search` call fires, for the final value | N/A |
| Query cleared | non-empty → empty/whitespace | pending timer cancelled, state → `ResourceIdle`, timeline shown, no request | N/A |
| Offline | any non-empty query, no connectivity | `ApiClient` → `Failure.networkOffline`, no cache fallback | `ResourceError(networkOffline)` rendered |
| Stale response | query A in flight, query B supersedes it | A's result discarded on arrival (generation mismatch) | N/A |
| Slow request | request exceeds 300ms | loading indicator appears | N/A — faster responses show none |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `entries_repository.dart` — add `search()`; fix stale "third and last method ... forever" comment (AD-11 is create+read-only, not count-capped).
- `entries_remote_data_source.dart:54-76` / `entries_repository_impl.dart:54-94` — `list()`'s try/catch + persist-then-return pattern to mirror; `search()` has no fallback branch.
- `meus_registros_cubit.dart:48-57` — `_generation` staleness-guard pattern to mirror.
- `lib/core/resource.dart` — existing `Resource<T>`; first real consumer.
- `meus_registros_screen.dart:117-153` — wire both cubits via nested `BlocBuilder`s.
- `entries_injection.dart:54-60`, `bootstrap_integration_test.dart:196-197` — DI registration + assertion patterns to mirror.
- `design_tokens.dart` — reuse `colorSurfaceElevated`, `radiusMd`, `elevation1`, `spacingMd/Lg`, `textBodyMd`, `insertionModalTapTargetMin`; no new token.

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [x] `entries_repository.dart` -- add `search(String query)` to the port
- [x] `entries_remote_data_source.dart` -- add `search()` calling `entries-search`
- [x] `entries_repository_impl.dart` -- implement `search()`: persist-then-return, no fallback
- [x] `presentation/cubit/entries_search_cubit.dart` (new) -- debounce + generation guard over `Resource<List<Entry>>`
- [x] `presentation/widgets/entries_search_bar.dart` (new) -- docked input, funnel icon, no submit button
- [x] `meus_registros_screen.dart` -- dock bar; branch render on search state
- [x] `entries_injection.dart` -- register `EntriesSearchCubit` as `lazySingleton`
- [x] `bootstrap_integration_test.dart` -- assert `EntriesSearchCubit` resolves
- [x] Unit tests covering every I/O Matrix row across the new/changed files
- [x] `test/features/entries/entries_search_flow_e2e_test.dart` (new) -- happy-path + offline; new real-pipeline surface, same rationale spec-4-4 used for `getById`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given a query "ansiedade", when results return, then they include an entry that only used "nervosismo" (semantic, not literal match).
- Given a user typing, when each keystroke lands, then the request is debounced 300ms — no request fires per keystroke.
- Given the search bar, when it renders, then it is permanently docked at the top of Meus Registros with a trailing funnel icon and is never submitted via a button.
- Given the user is offline, when a search is attempted, then it resolves to `Failure.networkOffline` immediately, never served from cache.

### Review Findings

**Patch:**
- [x] [Review][Patch] No skeleton ever appears for an already-in-flight search if `MeusRegistrosScreen` is torn down and remounted mid-search (e.g. the user navigates away via `context.go` to another tab and back while `EntriesSearchCubit` — a DI singleton — is still `ResourceLoading`): the fresh `_MeusRegistrosScreenState.initState` only arms `_skeletonTimer` for the first-page timeline, never inspecting `widget.searchCubit.state`, and `BlocConsumer`'s `listener` does not fire for a state that was already current at subscription time, so `_showSearchSkeleton` stays `false` until the search resolves. [lib/features/entries/presentation/screens/meus_registros_screen.dart:85-95] — fixed: `initState` now arms `_searchSkeletonTimer` when `widget.searchCubit.state` is already `ResourceLoading` at mount.
- [x] [Review][Patch] `_dedupedById`'s first-occurrence-wins de-duplication is implemented twice with near-identical semantics but different signatures — once in `MeusRegistrosCubit` (`List<Entry>`, optional `seenIds` for incremental pagination) and once newly added in `EntriesRepositoryImpl` (`List<EntryDto>`, no `seenIds`). The new one's own doc comment says it mirrors the other's convention, which is a direct signal they should share one implementation rather than drift as separate copies. [lib/features/entries/data/repositories/entries_repository_impl.dart:228] — fixed: extracted into a shared generic `dedupedById<T>()` in `lib/core/utils/deduped_by_id.dart`, used by both call sites.
- [x] [Review][Patch] No test exercises `EntriesSearchCubit` recovering from a `ResourceError` into a new successful search (`ResourceError` → `onQueryChanged(newQuery)` → `ResourceLoading` → `ResourceData`) — only idle→loading→data, idle→loading→error, and stale-response discarding are covered, so a regression that left the cubit stuck after one failed search would ship undetected. [test/features/entries/presentation/cubit/entries_search_cubit_test.dart] — fixed: added the recovery test.

**Defer:**
- [x] [Review][Defer] Returning to Meus Registros after navigating away mid-query (e.g. tapping a search result into entry detail, then back) shows stale search results in place of the timeline while the visible search box renders empty — `EntriesSearchCubit` is a `lazySingleton` whose `Resource` state outlives the screen, but `EntriesSearchBar`'s `TextField` has no `controller` to re-seed from it. [lib/features/entries/presentation/widgets/entries_search_bar.dart:38] — deferred; already self-documented by the author in `deferred-work.md` under "Deferred from: code review of spec-5-1-semantic-search-with-debounced-input" with the same rationale, so it is not re-added there as a duplicate entry.
- [x] [Review][Defer] No Dynamic Type / accessibility-scaling test exists for `EntriesSearchBar`, despite `epic-5-context.md`'s own UX note that "the search/filter surfaces are a tight-fit area for Dynamic Type — verify text does not truncate or clip at the largest accessibility size." [lib/features/entries/presentation/widgets/entries_search_bar.dart] — deferred, pre-existing gap: no screen or widget anywhere in the entries feature (stories 4.1–4.4 included) has a `textScaleFactor`/`TextScaler` test, so this isn't a regression specific to this story.
- [x] [Review][Defer] `search()`'s `dedupedDtos.map(_toEntry).toList()` call (producing the returned `List<Entry>`) sits after the `_entriesBox.putAll` try/catch, so an exception thrown while mapping a DTO to an `Entry` would escape unmapped (RNF09 expects every repository exception caught). [lib/features/entries/data/repositories/entries_repository_impl.dart:153] — deferred, pre-existing pattern: the identical gap already exists in `list()`/`getById()`'s own DTO→Entity mapping, so a fix belongs to all three methods together, not this one in isolation.

1	/// First-occurrence-wins de-duplication by a caller-supplied id, shared by
2	/// `MeusRegistrosCubit._dedupedById` (paginated `Entry` lists, with an
3	/// optional running [seenIds] set across pages) and
4	/// `EntriesRepositoryImpl.search()` (a single `EntryDto` list) — both are
5	/// trust-but-verify guards against the backend ever violating its own
6	/// no-duplicate-ids invariant.
7	List<T> dedupedById<T>(
8	  List<T> items,
9	  String Function(T item) idOf, {
10	  Set<String>? seenIds,
11	}) {
12	  final seen = {...?seenIds};
13	  return [
14	    for (final item in items)
15	      if (seen.add(idOf(item))) item,
16	  ];
17	}

# Test Automation Summary

## Scope

Story 4.4 (entry detail view) adds `EntriesRepository.getById` — the
repository's third and last method (AD-11) — reached through a new
`EntriesRemoteDataSource.get` -> `ApiClient` -> real `Dio`/interceptors ->
real `entries` Hive box path, exactly the kind of new real-pipeline
surface the prior (spec-4-3) run's own "Next Steps" flagged for this story
to re-check.

Review findings (round 2) also added/changed coverage beyond the story's
own scope:

- `EntryDetailCubit`'s `SessionStatus` composition was restructured to
  fold into the sealed `EntryDetailState` itself (previously a side
  field) — covered by new/updated tests in `entry_detail_cubit_test.dart`,
  including a case where the session expires while a `getById` fetch is
  still in flight (previously untested).
- A debounce guard on `EntryRecordCard`'s new `onTap` (a rapid double-tap
  could stack two pushes of the same detail route) — covered by a new
  widget test in `meus_registros_screen_test.dart`.
- A widget test asserting a tap landing specifically inside the card's
  colored spine strip (not just the content text) still calls `onTap` —
  guards the round-1 "whole-card tappable area" fix against regression.
- Two new `app_router_test.dart` cases proving the nested
  `/meus-registros/:id` route is gated by the shared `_redirect` the same
  as any other destination: bounced to `/auth` while `unauthenticated`,
  and never navigated away from while `expired` mid-session.

## Generated Tests

### E2E Tests

- [x] `test/features/entries/entry_detail_flow_e2e_test.dart` — drives the
  real DI-resolved `EntriesRepository.getById` through real
  `Dio`/interceptors and a real `entries` Hive box, answering the prior
  run's own open question:
  - Happy path: `getById()` fires one real GET to `entries-get/{id}` with
    the right URL/headers/body, resolves `Right`, and persists to the real
    Hive box.
  - Offline fallback: a `NETWORK_OFFLINE` response is genuinely retried
    `RetryInterceptor.maxRetries` times over the real retry pipeline
    before falling back to a real cached entry in the Hive box.
  - Not-found: a genuine `NOT_FOUND` response propagates as `Left` with no
    retry and no synthesized cache fallback.

### Other new/updated tests (unit + widget)

- `entry_detail_cubit_test.dart` — `SessionStatus` folded into
  `EntryDetailState`: stamped on the first emit, re-stamped on a later
  status change without disturbing resolved entry/badge data, and stamped
  correctly when the status changes mid-flight (before `getById`
  resolves).
- `entry_record_card_test.dart` — a tap inside the spine strip's own
  bounds calls `onTap`.
- `meus_registros_screen_test.dart` — a rapid double-tap on a card pushes
  the detail route only once.
- `app_router_test.dart` — the nested `:id` route redirects to `/auth`
  while unauthenticated, and stays put through a mid-session expiry.

## Verification

- `fvm flutter analyze` — zero issues.
- `fvm flutter test` — 721/721 passed (up from 679/679 in the spec-4-3
  run — 42 new tests: the 3 E2E cases above plus the round-2 review-fix
  unit/widget tests, with none removed).

## Coverage

- `entries.getById` (spec-4-4): success, offline-cache fallback, and
  not-found — all three real-pipeline paths now covered end-to-end, the
  same tier `entries.list`/`entries.create` already had.
- `entries.list`/`entries.create`/retry real-pipeline coverage remains in
  `entries_list_flow_e2e_test.dart` and `pending_write_sync_e2e_test.dart`
  (prior runs) — untouched and still green.
- `EntryDetailCubit`'s full I/O matrix (success, notFound, every other
  non-absorbed failure, offline/timeout cache fallback at the repository
  layer, the stale-generation guard, and now `SessionStatus` composition
  at every point in `load()`'s lifecycle) is covered against fakes in
  `entry_detail_cubit_test.dart`.
- Navigation wiring (card tap -> push, the nested route's own auth
  gating, debounce) is covered in `meus_registros_screen_test.dart`/
  `app_router_test.dart` against fakes, per this project's
  no-device-E2E-for-UI-taps convention.

## Next Steps

- Story 4.4 is the last story in Epic 4 (entries) — Epic 5 (search/
  filters) is next in delivery order; re-run this workflow once it's
  implemented to check whether it opens its own new real-pipeline surface
  worth an E2E test.
- If a device/simulator or CI step is introduced (AGENTS.md notes none
  exists yet), consider promoting the existing real-pipeline `test()`
  suites into `integration_test/` driver tests against a real target.

# Test Automation Summary

## Scope

Story 5.1 (semantic search with debounced input) moved to `done`, including an uncommitted round-2 review patch (`search()`'s own de-dupe, a `MeusRegistrosScreen` skeleton-arm fix, and a cubit recovery test). Cross-checking every I/O-matrix row, acceptance criterion, and round-2 review finding against the existing suite found the feature's own test coverage (cubit, data source, repository, widget, e2e) already comprehensive — six scenarios, both round-1 and round-2 regressions, all exercised. Two concrete gaps remained, both tied directly to the uncommitted patch rather than to the story's original scope:

1. The patch's `initState` fix in `meus_registros_screen.dart` (arms the search skeleton when `EntriesSearchCubit` — a DI singleton — is already `ResourceLoading` at remount) had no test anywhere; every existing "slow request" case only starts a search *after* mount.
2. The patch's extraction of `dedupedById<T>()` into `lib/core/utils/deduped_by_id.dart` (shared by `MeusRegistrosCubit` and `EntriesRepositoryImpl.search()`) left the new generic untested in isolation — both callers' own tests only exercise it indirectly through their own `Entry`/`EntryDto` call sites.

Two items the spec's own round-2 review explicitly deferred (Dynamic Type coverage for `EntriesSearchBar`; the DTO→Entity mapping exception-safety gap in `list()`/`getById()`/`search()`) are left alone — both are pre-existing, feature-wide gaps the spec itself scoped out of this story, not something to fold in silently here.

## Generated Tests

### Widget test (screen-level regression guard)

- [x] `test/features/entries/presentation/screens/meus_registros_screen_test.dart` — new case in the `spec-5-1: docked search bar` group: starts a search, lets it debounce into `ResourceLoading` (held open via the fake repository's `searchGate`), tears the screen down and remounts it against the *same* `MeusRegistrosCubit`/`EntriesSearchCubit` instances (mirroring the real DI-singleton lifetime), then asserts the search skeleton stays blank below 300ms and appears past it — proving the new `initState` arms fresh on remount rather than staying blank forever.
  - Verified the test actually guards the fix: temporarily reverted just the patch's `initState` branch, re-ran the new test alone, confirmed it failed (`Found 0 widgets with type "EntrySkeletonCard"`), then restored the file and confirmed `git diff --stat` matched the original uncommitted diff exactly before re-running the full suite.

### Unit tests (new shared utility)

- [x] `test/core/utils/deduped_by_id_test.dart` (new file) — direct coverage of `dedupedById<T>()`: first-occurrence-wins on a duplicate id, an already-unique list returned unchanged and in order, an empty list, the `seenIds` parameter dropping an item not repeated within the list itself, the caller's own `seenIds` set never being mutated, and genericity over a non-`String` item type keyed by a caller-supplied field.

## Verification

- `fvm flutter analyze` — zero issues.
- `fvm flutter test` — 765/765 passed (7 new tests: 1 widget + 6 unit; none removed).

## Coverage

- Story 5.1's own six I/O-matrix rows (semantic match, rapid typing, query cleared, offline, stale response, slow request) and all three round-2 review-fix regressions (recovery from error, non-const `ResourceLoading` emits, de-dupe) were already covered before this run, across `entries_search_cubit_test.dart`, `entries_search_bar_test.dart`, `entries_remote_data_source_test.dart`, `entries_repository_impl_test.dart`, `meus_registros_screen_test.dart`, `bootstrap_integration_test.dart`, and `entries_search_flow_e2e_test.dart` (real-pipeline happy path + offline).
- The one screen-level round-2 patch without coverage (remount-while-loading skeleton arm) and the one new shared utility without direct coverage (`dedupedById<T>()`) are both covered now.
- Deferred, by design, not by oversight: Dynamic Type/accessibility-scaling coverage for `EntriesSearchBar` (pre-existing feature-wide gap per the spec's own round-2 review) and exception-safety for the DTO→Entity mapping step in `list()`/`getById()`/`search()` (same pre-existing pattern across all three repository methods) — both explicitly deferred in `spec-5-1-semantic-search-with-debounced-input.md` and `deferred-work.md`, not story-5.1-specific regressions.

## Next Steps

- Story 5.2 (metadata filters) is next in delivery order (`sprint-status.yaml`: `backlog`) — re-run this workflow once it's implemented, since it reactivates `EntriesSearchBar`'s currently-inert funnel icon and will need its own I/O-matrix coverage.
- The deferred stale-search-box-on-remount bug (`EntriesSearchBar`'s uncontrolled `TextField` never re-seeding from the cubit's live query) remains a real, acknowledged gap in `deferred-work.md` — it's a product/UX defect, not a missing test, so it wasn't addressed here.

# Test Automation Summary

## Scope

Story 4.4 (entry detail view) adds `EntriesRepository.getById` — the
repository's third and last method (AD-11) — reached through a new
`EntriesRemoteDataSource.get` -> `ApiClient` -> real `Dio`/interceptors ->
real `entries` Hive box path, exactly the kind of new real-pipeline
surface the prior (spec-4-3) run's own "Next Steps" flagged for this story
to re-check.

Review findings (round 2) also added/changed coverage beyond the story's
own scope:

- `EntryDetailCubit`'s `SessionStatus` composition was restructured to
  fold into the sealed `EntryDetailState` itself (previously a side
  field) — covered by new/updated tests in `entry_detail_cubit_test.dart`,
  including a case where the session expires while a `getById` fetch is
  still in flight (previously untested).
- A debounce guard on `EntryRecordCard`'s new `onTap` (a rapid double-tap
  could stack two pushes of the same detail route) — covered by a new
  widget test in `meus_registros_screen_test.dart`.
- A widget test asserting a tap landing specifically inside the card's
  colored spine strip (not just the content text) still calls `onTap` —
  guards the round-1 "whole-card tappable area" fix against regression.
- Two new `app_router_test.dart` cases proving the nested
  `/meus-registros/:id` route is gated by the shared `_redirect` the same
  as any other destination: bounced to `/auth` while `unauthenticated`,
  and never navigated away from while `expired` mid-session.

## Generated Tests

### E2E Tests

- [x] `test/features/entries/entry_detail_flow_e2e_test.dart` — drives the
  real DI-resolved `EntriesRepository.getById` through real
  `Dio`/interceptors and a real `entries` Hive box, answering the prior
  run's own open question:
  - Happy path: `getById()` fires one real GET to `entries-get/{id}` with
    the right URL/headers/body, resolves `Right`, and persists to the real
    Hive box.
  - Offline fallback: a `NETWORK_OFFLINE` response is genuinely retried
    `RetryInterceptor.maxRetries` times over the real retry pipeline
    before falling back to a real cached entry in the Hive box.
  - Not-found: a genuine `NOT_FOUND` response propagates as `Left` with no
    retry and no synthesized cache fallback.

### Other new/updated tests (unit + widget)

- `entry_detail_cubit_test.dart` — `SessionStatus` folded into
  `EntryDetailState`: stamped on the first emit, re-stamped on a later
  status change without disturbing resolved entry/badge data, and stamped
  correctly when the status changes mid-flight (before `getById`
  resolves).
- `entry_record_card_test.dart` — a tap inside the spine strip's own
  bounds calls `onTap`.
- `meus_registros_screen_test.dart` — a rapid double-tap on a card pushes
  the detail route only once.
- `app_router_test.dart` — the nested `:id` route redirects to `/auth`
  while unauthenticated, and stays put through a mid-session expiry.

## Verification

- `fvm flutter analyze` — zero issues.
- `fvm flutter test` — 721/721 passed (up from 679/679 in the spec-4-3
  run — 42 new tests: the 3 E2E cases above plus the round-2 review-fix
  unit/widget tests, with none removed).

## Coverage

- `entries.getById` (spec-4-4): success, offline-cache fallback, and
  not-found — all three real-pipeline paths now covered end-to-end, the
  same tier `entries.list`/`entries.create` already had.
- `entries.list`/`entries.create`/retry real-pipeline coverage remains in
  `entries_list_flow_e2e_test.dart` and `pending_write_sync_e2e_test.dart`
  (prior runs) — untouched and still green.
- `EntryDetailCubit`'s full I/O matrix (success, notFound, every other
  non-absorbed failure, offline/timeout cache fallback at the repository
  layer, the stale-generation guard, and now `SessionStatus` composition
  at every point in `load()`'s lifecycle) is covered against fakes in
  `entry_detail_cubit_test.dart`.
- Navigation wiring (card tap -> push, the nested route's own auth
  gating, debounce) is covered in `meus_registros_screen_test.dart`/
  `app_router_test.dart` against fakes, per this project's
  no-device-E2E-for-UI-taps convention.

## Next Steps

- Story 4.4 is the last story in Epic 4 (entries) — Epic 5 (search/
  filters) is next in delivery order; re-run this workflow once it's
  implemented to check whether it opens its own new real-pipeline surface
  worth an E2E test.
- If a device/simulator or CI step is introduced (AGENTS.md notes none
  exists yet), consider promoting the existing real-pipeline `test()`
  suites into `integration_test/` driver tests against a real target.
